title: Historic East Nashville 2BR • Minutes to Broadway
description:
A quick ride to Broadway, but in a charming and cool neighborhood where you can get a good night's sleep. Stay in this charming historic retreat steps away from the best spots in Lockeland Springs for coffee, restaurants, bars, music and shopping. 

The bungalow has been lovingly updated to create a unique twist on old school southern style with a bit of new school edge. Enjoy the eclectic home while playing the piano or simply sit on the front porch swing and sip that morning cup of coffee.

The space
This is a side-by-side duplex which has a shared wall with the neighboring unit so some daily noise should be anticipated. If you have any concerns about this please reach out and we can make sure this is a good fit. Both units do have their own private entrances, porches and separate fenced yards including gates at the street.

If you're looking for a friendly place to retreat to with walkable hot spots to enjoy this is the place. The immediate neighborhood and street are generally quiet with lovely neighbors, but within a stone’s throw and a short walk are neighborhood gems and nightlife.

Coffee, restaurants, bars, music and shopping – Within a 10 min walk.
Urban Cowboy, Mama Bread, Groceries Etc. and Lockeland Table - 5 min walk
Bill’s Sandwich Palace, The Den and Freshie and Zero - on the corner.
Downtown & Nissan Stadium – 8 min drive
Ryman Auditorium – 11 min drive
Grand Ole Opry – 17 min drive

Book your stay and experience Nashville like a local!

Other things to note
Quiet hours are observed from 10pm to 8am daily including weekends.
